name: Crocolisk Tear (Classic)
summary: At the Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir needs a Crocolisk Tear to counter Dark Iron explosives.

sections.title: A Curious Component
sections.body: Crocolisk Tears come from reptiles living in Loch Modan's waters. Chief Engineer Hinderweir found that their secretions have an unexpected use. Mixed with potent spider venom and resonant ogre minerals, a tear has the chemical properties needed to counter volatile Dark Iron demolition charges threatening the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: What is a Crocolisk Tear used for?
aliases: why do i need crocolisk tear
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir at the Stonewrought Dam needs a Crocolisk Tear for a mixture meant to disarm explosives planted by Dark Iron saboteurs.

faq.q: Where can Crocolisk Tears be gathered?
faq.answer: Loch Crocolisks and Large Loch Crocolisks live in Loch Modan's waters and shallows, where their tears can be gathered.

faq.q: What other materials are combined with the tear?
aliases: what else is needed with crocolisk tear
faq.answer: Hinderweir combines the tear with Lurker Venom from local forest spiders and a Mo'grosh Crystal from the ogres of the northeastern hills to make the defusing agent.

angles.text: Dwarven engineers such as Chief Engineer Hinderweir use unusual alchemical compounds to neutralize advanced explosives when conventional tools cannot suffice.
